claim: Advertisements promoting Donald Trump and his policies may have breached U.S. laws that prohibit the use of public government funds for political advertising, prompting Trump to announce he will cease using taxpayer money for such ads following bipartisan criticism.
supports: The ads, which tout Trump and his policies, could have violated US laws barring public government funds being spent on political advertising.
Trump says he will stop using taxpayer funds for ads after bipartisan pushback
